fields.label: Sync Enabled
fields.description: When unchecked, inbound QBO payment events are logged as Skipped-NoOp and no Payment Entries are created or cancelled.

fields.label: Webhook Shared Secret (HMAC)
fields.description: Shared secret used by n8n to sign requests to receive_payment_event (X-QBO-Signature = HMAC-SHA256 hex over the raw body). Generate a random 64-char value and store the same value in n8n. If site_config.json defines qbo_webhook_secret, that value takes precedence.

fields.label: Paid To Account
fields.description: Bank/Cash account that QBO-originated payments post to.

fields.label: Push Enabled
fields.description: Automatically push submitted Sales Invoices, credit notes, customer receipts and cancellations to QuickBooks through the n8n proxy workflow. Turn off the old n8n invoice workflow first.

fields.label: n8n QuickBooks Proxy URL
fields.description: Production URL of the n8n workflow 'QuickBooks API Proxy' (n8n_workflows/quickbooks_api_proxy.json). Signed with the Webhook Shared Secret above.

fields.label: Push Documents Posted On/After
fields.description: Auto-push only documents with a posting date on or after this date. Older ones can be sent with Backfill or Push Now.

fields.label: Apply Credit Notes to the Original Invoice
fields.description: When ERPNext reduces the original invoice (Update Outstanding for Self off), apply the QuickBooks credit memo to it with a $0 payment.

fields.label: Push Customer Payments
fields.description: Payment Entries (Receive, Customer) entered in ERPNext. Payments that came from QuickBooks are never pushed back.

fields.label: Default QuickBooks Item
fields.description: Product/Service in QuickBooks used for invoice lines (create it as a Service or Non-inventory item with your sales income account).

fields.label: QuickBooks Item for Taxes & Charges
fields.description: Used for ERPNext tax/charge rows and rounding. Blank = Default QuickBooks Item. Use a non-taxable item tied to your sales-tax-payable or other liability account.

fields.label: QuickBooks Line Tax Code
fields.description: TaxCodeRef sent on every line. US companies: NON (ERPNext already calculated tax). Blank = omit.

fields.label: QuickBooks Deposit Account for Payments
fields.description: Name of the QuickBooks bank account payments pushed from ERPNext deposit to. Blank = Undeposited Funds / Payments to deposit.

fields.label: Endpoint Help
fields.options:
Inbound (QuickBooks payments → ERPNext): n8n posts to /api/method/illumenate_lighting.illumenate_lighting.api.qbo_sync.receive_payment_event; every event is in ilL-QBO-Sync-Log. Workflow: n8n_workflows/quickbooks_payment_sync.json.

Outbound (ERPNext → QuickBooks): every push is an ilL-QBO-Push-Log row, sent through n8n_workflows/quickbooks_api_proxy.json. Use the buttons above to test the connection, retry failures and backfill.

Setup: docs/QBO_CONNECTOR_SETUP_AND_TEST.md.
